faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Get clear answers to the most common questions regarding visa applications, fees, and requirements.
faq.viewAll: View all questions in FAQ section
faq.q1: How early should I apply for my visa before my travel date?
faq.a1: We recommend starting your visa application at least 4 to 8 weeks before your intended departure date. Consulates such as Schengen states, the US, and the UK experience seasonal peaks where appointment slots and processing can take longer.
faq.a2: No ethical visa consultancy can guarantee an embassy's sovereign decision. However, SK Visa Experts ensures that your file is 100% compliant, accurate, and optimized according to the latest consular guidelines, giving you the highest probability of approval.
faq.q3: Can you provide verifiable flight and hotel reservations for my visa file?
faq.a3: Yes. We generate verifiable flight itineraries with active PNRs and confirmed hotel reservations tailored for visa submissions, avoiding non-refundable ticket purchases prior to visa issuance.
faq.q4: Which payment methods are accepted at SK Visa Experts?
faq.a4: We support multiple secure payment options: Stripe, PayPal, JazzCash, Easypaisa, local Saudi Bank Transfers (IBAN), Tap Payments, Telr, and PayTabs.
faq.q5: Where is your office located in Riyadh and what are your opening hours?
faq.a5: We are located at Umm Al Hamam St, Umm Al Hamam Al Sharqi, Riyadh 12321, Saudi Arabia. Our office opens at 8:00 AM on Saturday. Other days are currently to be confirmed; please reach out to us on WhatsApp or phone at +966 59 932 6936 for prior appointments.
